title: Animal Justice Exposes Ag-Gag Misinformation
reason: Discusses the controversy surrounding ag-gag laws and their impact on animal cruelty reporting.

tasks.task: Describe the release of Animal Justice’s report on disease outbreaks in Canadian farms.

subtasks.text: Note the release of Animal Justice's report on disease outbreaks in Canadian farms.

tasks.task: Explain the purpose of ag-gag laws and their effect on whistleblowers.

subtasks.text: Observe that ag-gag laws punish whistleblowers and conceal animal cruelty.
Mention that ag-gag laws have been passed in several provinces and a federal bill is underway.

tasks.task: Detail the threats posed by ag-gag laws.

subtasks.text: Highlight that Bill C-275 threatens to jail people who go into farms to expose animal cruelty.
Note the fines of up to half a million dollars associated with ag-gag laws.

tasks.task: Provide counterarguments to the reasoning behind ag-gag laws.

subtasks.text: Observe that supporters often argue ag-gag laws are needed for disease prevention.
Highlight that Animal Justice's report shows outbreaks are often caused by poor farming practices.
Note the specific poor farming practices mentioned, such as needle-sharing and inadequate disinfection.

tasks.task: Conclude by emphasizing the real biosecurity risk.

subtasks.text: Mention that the real biosecurity risk is farmers themselves.
Encourage viewers to help stop ag-gag laws by signing a petition.
